rationale: ORSR deed collection is a durable, diffable filing timeline dating leadership and structural changes at source.
Mandatory financial-statements/annual-report register; filing dates plus org, headcount and board data for banks and PSPs.
RPVS is a standalone UBO/verification register with dated filings revealing quiet ownership and control changes.
RPO is the only NACE-searchable way to enumerate the whole SK financial/payments actor population.
Machine-readable RPO API contract with change-since filters; enables automated org-change monitoring.
Slovensko.Digital republishes all key SK registers via REST/SQL APIs and dumps — highest-leverage single feed.
FinStat normalises 13 registers into per-company event timelines with alerts/API, but monitoring is a paid account.
Static MS SR FAQ page on a domain with many siblings; interpretation reference, not a signal producer.
e-Justice SK country page is a gateway sub-page; useful only for cross-border lookups already covered by ORSR/BRIS.
One-off metadata description of the ICO identifier scheme; read once to fix the join key, never re-monitored.
Second commercial register aggregator, low credibility and redundant with FinStat and Slovensko.Digital.
Single law-firm article decoding 2024 merger/registration rules; a one-off interpretation aid.
Generic trade-press procedural explainer; low credibility and duplicated by official methodology pages.
SBA member list is the canonical SK bank population; mine once for the actor seed list, re-check occasionally.
SBA presidium page is a continuously refreshed CEO-level directory; diffs are direct leadership-move signals.
Association press room publishing leadership elections and sector-employment announcements at source.
SBA training arm; weak, indirect hiring proxy adding little beyond the parent association.
AOCP member list enumerates licensed investment firms — mine once for the capital-markets actor set.
SAPIE directory is the broadest source of fintech/payments actors missing from banking registers.
ITAS members are the bank-IT/payments vendor employer population; mine once as a hiring-signal seed list.
A single dated board-election post; evidence of one leadership snapshot, the news section is the real source.
AmCham board roster names executives with employers incl. financial sector; diffable leadership signal.
300+ member directory including banks, PSPs and shared-service employers; high-yield one-off lead mine.
Committee rosters sit on the AmCham about page already covered by the board/member entries.
Fintech association board page names payments-sector leaders; small but on-scope leadership directory.
Member directory of the non-bank payments segment that regulator registers only partly cover.
AFISP unites major financial-intermediation firms; mine once for advisory-network employers and committee names.
SLASPO insurer directory covers bancassurance-adjacent, often bank-owned actors; one-off lead extraction.
